ProgramBench Generated Tests
	

This dataset contains the AI-generated behavioral test suites used to evaluate model solutions in ProgramBench.
ProgramBench is a benchmark that evaluates whether language models can rebuild programs from scratch. Given only a compiled binary and its documentation, AI agents must architect and implement a complete codebase that reproduces the original program's behavior.
